label: Sleeping Beauty sampling and settlement algebra by exact rational algebra
description: For every supplied non-dogmatic rational experiment prior p and positive Tails awakening count k, retained-slot conditioning equals p/[p+k(1-p)], which is strictly between zero and one, equals p iff k=1, and is less than p when k>1. Experiment-settled and awakening-settled fixed unit Heads tickets have expected gains p-c and p-c*[p+k(1-p)]; their unique zero-gain prices are respectively p and p/[p+k(1-p)]. This is prospective linear-utility protocol algebra, not a norm selecting Beauty's credence. Scope and provisional assessment: docs/notes/sleeping-beauty-1401.md. No root premise change; the applicability/warrant bridge to issues #931 and #934 remains unbuilt.
